create.title: Complete actual twelfth-moment reduction to distinct large squarefree classes
create.statement_tex: Fix a nonnegative real radial smooth unit-mass mollifier supported in the unit disk, Psi(s)=rho-hat(s e1), and a fixed nonnegative smooth w supported in [1/2,2] and equal1 on [1/sqrt(2),sqrt(3)]. For real T>=2 let a_n(T)=r2(n)n^(-3/4)Psi(sqrt(n/T)), f_d(R)=sum_(s>=1)a_(d s^2)(T)cos(2pi R s sqrt(d)-3pi/4), Q=floor(T^(2/5)), L_Q=sum_(squarefree d<=Q)f_d, Z_Q=sum_(squarefree d>Q)f_d, B_T=L_Q+Z_Q, E12=sum_(ordered pairwise distinct squarefree d_1,...,d_12>Q)product_j f_(d_j), I12=integral w(R/T)E12(R)dR and M_p(F)=integral w(R/T)|F|^p dR. With the existing qualified Li--Yang exponent theta_LY and beta=2theta_LY-1/2, M12(L_Q)<<_epsilon T^(15/13+epsilon) and integral w(R/T)|Z_Q^12-E12|dR<<_epsilon T^(8beta-1/5+epsilon). Consequently |M12(Z_Q)-I12| obeys the latter error bound. The complete high-value bound integral_(|B_T|>T^(13/125))w|B_T|^12<<T^(29/25+epsilon), the full B_T twelfth-moment bound at that power, the full Z_Q bound at that power, and |I12|<<T^(29/25+epsilon) are equivalent, with every bound quantified for each epsilon>0. A one-sided upper bound on real I12 suffices. None of these equivalent target bounds is proved here. The exact signed partition identity pays every repeated-class configuration collectively, including nonzero and nonpairing relations, with all harmonics, signs, blocks, tails, real endpoints and floor retained. Distinct-class frequencies are nonzero but no sufficient separation or cancellation estimate is proved. This is not an additive approximation to M12(B_T), a new complete moment or pointwise exponent, a sufficient unbounded-order family, or a proof of any M1/M2/GAR parent, endpoint or the quarter theorem.
create.next_action: At mandatory broad strategy/current-literature review217 compare the complete remaining distinct-class signed integral and anchored energy with all full-proof frontiers. The 29/25 target and full quarter theorem remain open; preserve every inherited source qualification.

round_assessment.reason: Accept the completely paid reduction of the actual twelfth moment to twelve distinct large squarefree classes. The head costs T^(15/13+epsilon), and the collective repeated-class error costs T^(8beta-1/5+epsilon). The remaining signed distinct-class estimate at T^(29/25+epsilon) is unproved. Retain the anchored divisor conditional interface and scoped controls without promoting their missing arithmetic input.
